reason: I could not refute the claim; every checkable element held up against sources I opened. (1) Cited source: the App Store page (US storefront, and the AE storefront as a cross-check) lists Shj AI Guide, seller "Sharjah Commerce & Tourism Development Authority", current version 7.0 dated 21 December 2022, with release note "Enabled users to use voice with Fatima"; the version history runs 1.0 (2 Oct 2019) to 7.0 (21 Dec 2022). Apple's lookup API (itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=1480995300) returns version "7.0", currentVersionReleaseDate "2022-12-21T10:33:28Z", languageCodesISO2A AR/EN/DE/RU/ZH. The full description describes only a 24-hour virtual tour guide answering "by voice or written messages" in five languages and says to "ask your AI Tour Guide to help you plan, book and explore"; it mentions no AR, map, itinerary builder, or sustainability feature. (2) "Only official app": Apple's developer lookup for artistId 919402695 (itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=919402695&entity=software) returns resultCount 2, i.e. the artist record plus a single app, Shj AI Guide; the developer page shows the same single app. On Google Play, four searches ("Shj AI Guide", the authority's full name, "SCTDA Sharjah", "Sharjah Tourism") surfaced no app by SCTDA, and the Android package the app once had (com.visitsharjah.assistant, linked from Labiba's 2019 announcement) now returns HTTP 404. SCTDA's own sites (sharjahtourism.ae, visitsharjah.com, sustainsharjah.com) carry no app links. SCTDA's October 2024 "Sustainable Tourism AI Assistant" (40+ languages) is described as a virtual assistant shown via a Holobox avatar, not a store app, and it post-dates the app's last build so cannot be inside it; SharjahVerse (2022) has no store listing. (3) Independent source: Labiba's news page (labiba.ai/jo/en/news/27/sharjah-tourism) describes Fatima as a voice- and text-based AI tour guide with a TripAdvisor integration for recommendations, again with no map, AR, itinerary, or sustainability feature. Caveats: the "no map/itinerary" finding rests on the store listing and press descriptions, since I could not install the app or view its screens; the listing does promise chat-based help to "plan" and "book", which is assistance through the chatbot rather than an itinerary-builder feature; Google Play search pages were truncated, though the known package 404s; the shared web-search budget ran out before two final searches (WAM 2019 coverage; whether the Sustainable Tourism AI Assistant has a store listing), so those were covered by direct fetches of SCTDA's sites instead.
